scenarios.title: A｜剂量
scenarios.setting: 玩家拿到医生开的药，但不确定应该吃多少。

turns.text: Could you tell me how I’m supposed to take this?
Sure. Take one tablet twice a day.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: So that’s two tablets a day in total?

feedback.naturalExpression: So that’s two tablets a day in total?
feedback.explanation: “in total”指合计，强调所有项目加在一起的数额。

choices.text: Should I take one tablet each time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I take one tablet each time?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: What happens if I accidentally take more than one?

feedback.naturalExpression: What happens if I accidentally take more than one?
feedback.explanation: 问清后续处理或结果，能在行动前了解可能的影响。

choices.text: Is this the same dose every day?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is this the same dose every day?
feedback.explanation: “every day”表示每天重复发生，区别于只发生一次的情况。

choices.text: How many medicine should I eat each time?

feedback.naturalExpression: So that’s two tablets a day in total?
feedback.explanation: “medicine”通常不可数，药物用“take”而非“eat”；问每次用量可说“How much should I take each time?”。

turns.text: Yes, one tablet each time, twice a day. Don’t take more than the recommended dose.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: Okay. And how long should I take it for?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. And how long should I take it for?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Do I keep taking it until it’s finished?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I keep taking it until it’s finished?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Should I stop taking it once I feel better?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I stop taking it once I feel better?
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

turns.text: Follow the instructions on the label. If you’re unsure about stopping it early, check with your doctor.

turns.prompt: 关于「询问药物用法」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. I’ll follow the instructions on the label.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll follow the instructions on the label.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay, thanks for explaining.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thanks for explaining.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: B｜服用时间
scenarios.setting: 在“询问药物用法”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“服用时间”。

turns.text: When should I take this medication?
Take it twice a day, preferably about twelve hours apart.

turns.prompt: 你想确认用药时间是否合适，会怎么说？

choices.text: So morning and evening would be okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: So morning and evening would be okay?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Should I take it at the same time every day?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I take it at the same time every day?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Do I need to take it with food?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to take it with food?
feedback.explanation: “with food”在服药问答中指与食物同服；用这个短语确认服用要求，比只问何时吃药更具体。

choices.text: Can I take it on an empty stomach?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I take it on an empty stomach?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Should I eat this medicine before food?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: So morning and evening would be okay?
feedback.explanation: 服药用“take medicine”，不用“eat”；饭前可说“before meals”。

turns.text: It’s better to take this one with food.

turns.prompt: 你想确认药物和进餐时间应该怎样安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Should I take it before or after I eat?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I take it before or after I eat?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Would taking it right after breakfast be okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would taking it right after breakfast be okay?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: What if I forget to take a dose?

feedback.naturalExpression: What if I forget to take a dose?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

turns.text: If you miss a dose, follow the instructions on the label or contact us if you’re unsure.

turns.prompt: 关于「询问药物用法」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll check the label if that happens.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll check the label if that happens.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Got it. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: C｜副作用 / 注意事项
scenarios.setting: 在“询问药物用法”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“副作用 / 注意事项”。

turns.text: Are there any side effects I should know about?
Some people feel a little sleepy or dizzy after taking it.

turns.prompt: 你想确认服药后是否影响驾驶，会怎么问？

choices.text: Is it safe to drive after taking it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it safe to drive after taking it?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Is there anything I should avoid while I’m taking this?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I should avoid while I’m taking this?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: What should I do if I start feeling dizzy?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I do if I start feeling dizzy?
feedback.explanation: “dizzy”指头晕的，描述当下不适。

choices.text: Are there any serious side effects I should watch out for?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any serious side effects I should watch out for?
feedback.explanation: “side effects”指药物的副作用，能把所问的影响说得更具体。

choices.text: Does this medicine have bad effects?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is it safe to drive after taking it?
feedback.explanation: 药物副作用叫“side effects”；“bad effects”过于笼统。

turns.text: Until you know how it affects you, avoid driving if it makes you sleepy or dizzy.

turns.prompt: 你想询问服药期间需要注意的搭配禁忌，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Can I drink alcohol while I’m taking it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Can I drink alcohol while I’m taking it?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Can I take it with my other medications?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I take it with my other medications?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Is there anything else I should be careful about?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else I should be careful about?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

turns.text: If you’re taking any other medication, let me know so I can check for possible interactions.

turns.prompt: 你想请专业人员核对同时使用的药物是否合适，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m taking another medication every morning. Could you check whether they’re okay to take together?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m taking another medication every morning. Could you check whether they’re okay to take together?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Sure. I can show you what else I’m taking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I can show you what else I’m taking.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。
